nodes.question: What is the average decline in monitored fish populations according to the Freshwater Living Planet Index?
nodes.answer: The average decline in monitored fish populations according to the Freshwater Living Planet Index is 76%.

These data show that cycads (an ancient group of plants) are most threatened, while corals are declining fastest. Baseline RLI values are available for additional groups which have only been assessed once; reptiles have a similar initial RLI value to mammals, and dragonflies a similar RLI value to birds.
